audit.whatIsWrong: Full layer rates this HARD 8/10 with every phase given to Pantheon, while content win[], the packet chart (all Taliyah) and the 51.38% win rate over 578 games all say Taliyah is favored throughout. The two layers cannot both ship.
audit.why: Kit supports the Taliyah read: her 1000-range Q vs his 575-range Comet Spear, mines that stun his only dash, and a fading late game. Chart moved to match content and packet; diff/diffRating/difficulty text left alone pending a mirror decision (see notes).
Content spikes are sound: levels 3-5 out-range window, level 6 a roam-vs-roam standoff, first item Q-chunk spike, late Pantheon falls off. Full-layer chart brought into agreement.

audit.whatIsWrong: Aegis Assault being a CC-cancellable channel and the mines stunning his Shield Vault dash were both absent from the full layer (missing-interaction file); cooldowns field had no digits.
audit.why: Kit: E Aegis Assault 22s, channel, front-only invulnerability — any Taliyah CC cancels it; W Shield Vault 13s dash — Taliyah's E text says dashes through mines explode and stun; R Grand Starfall 180s, 5500 range.
audit.corrected: Folded into breakdown.cooldowns, dosFull[1].d and phase whys.

audit.why: Real numbers in kit: W 13s, E 22s, R 180s.

edits.before: - Pantheon Shield Vault (Stun): matchup-defining — Point-and-click stun — respect the all-in any time it is up. Read it like a second minimap. - Guard your W Seismic Shove like a fifth summoner spell. - Ultimate goes to kill windows only.
edits.after: Shield Vault runs 13s at rank 1 — every commit question is whether it is down. Aegis Assault is a 22s channel and your Q, W or E cancels it outright: break the front-block, never wait it out. His 180s Grand Starfall exists to leave lane — ping it and answer with your wall. Guard your 14s W.

edits.before: Q from fresh ground on his last-hit, and if he steps to answer, W-shove him across the E-field — the full geometry trade is half a health bar.
edits.after: Shield Vault is a dash — vaulting through your E-field stuns him out of his own combo, and your W flings him back off you before Aegis Assault starts.

edits.before: Trading while standing on your own Worked Ground — one-stone Qs lose every exchange your positioning already conceded.
edits.after: Mortal Will empowers every few of his casts — the longer the brawl, the more empowered Comet Spears you eat; take the geometry trade and step out.

edits.before: Flash + Teleport or Ignite — TP doubles the roam thesis; Ignite converts the W-E burst into early deletions. Pick by how hard you intend to roam.
edits.after: Flash + Teleport or Ignite — TP extends the roam plan to side lanes; Ignite converts the W-E burst into early deletions. Pick by how hard you plan to roam.

edits.before: Ahead, multiply: crash waves, wall-surf to every lane, and seed stones at each objective — a roaming Taliyah lead compounds faster than any lane bully's.
edits.after: Ahead, multiply: crash waves, wall-surf to every lane, and seed stones at objectives — a fading Pantheon must roam to matter, and your wall answers every leap.

edits.before: Q on fresh ground shreds level-1 trades — most mids don't expect five stones at minute two. Manage your Worked Ground like mana.
edits.after: You out-range him at level 1 — Threaded Volley's 1000 range beats his 575 Comet Spear; poke him and give no free spears.

edits.before: W online: the shove-displacement already threatens kill angles against overstep-happy laners.
edits.after: W online: fling him back the instant he Shield Vaults in — his own stun dash becomes your setup.

edits.before: Full kit: W-into-E is the signature burst — shove him across the stones and watch half a health bar disappear.
edits.after: Full kit: his W dash through your E-field stuns him for you — his all-in feeds your combo if the mines are down.

edits.before: Lost Chapter timing — Q-poke on every wave contact. Fresh-ground positioning is your real skill expression now.
edits.after: Lost Chapter timing — Q-poke every wave; zone him off CS from a range his 575-range spear can never answer.

edits.before: Weaver's Wall online — you are now the best roaming mid in the game. Every shove is a bot-lane gank announcement.
edits.after: Level 6: Grand Starfall is a roam button, not a duel — ping his 180s R and answer cross-map with your wall.

edits.before: Luden's spike: the W-E-Q rotation deletes squishies. Force river fights where your stones pre-seed the geometry.
edits.after: Luden's spike: max-range Q chunks him on every wave while his early spike fades — win every extended exchange.

edits.before: Late Taliyah edits maps: wall their reinforcements, shove their frontline into your team, and Q whatever stands on stones.
edits.after: Late he falls off hard: with two items the W-E detonation deletes him whenever Shield Vault is down. Wall his flanks anyway.

notes: All 4 lintFindings fixed. Chart: full sides were all Pantheon while content win[] and the packet chart were all Taliyah — moved full to match (win[] edits omitted, already correct). REMAINING INCOHERENCE FOR QA/USER: full-layer diff is still 'HARD', diffRating 8/10, carryRating 8.5/10, and breakdown.difficulty/report[14] say 'Hard matchup — difficulty 8/10' — that now sits oddly next to an all-Taliyah chart and 51.38% WR.
